by
  unfold selfDualHaarAt; exact Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure.nnreal_smul _ (NNReal.rpow_pos (zero_lt_one.trans (NumberField.HeightOneSpectrum.one_lt_absNorm_nnreal p))).ne'
explanation: Mathlib's declaration says that scaling an additive Haar measure by any nonzero NNReal produces another additive Haar measure. Unfolding `selfDualHaarAt` gives such a scalar multiple; positivity of the absolute norm makes its real power nonzero. The current proof already applies this declaration.
